content:
Extract the invoice data from the document below into JSON with exactly this schema:

{
  "vendor_name": "string",
  "invoice_number": "string",
  "invoice_date": "YYYY-MM-DD",
  "due_date": "YYYY-MM-DD or null if not applicable",
  "currency": "3-letter ISO code",
  "subtotal": 0.00,
  "tax_amount": 0.00,
  "total": 0.00,
  "line_items": [
    {"description": "string", "quantity": 0, "unit_price": 0.00, "amount": 0.00}
  ]
}

Note: subtotal means all pre-tax charges (including shipping and after discounts).

Return only the JSON object, nothing else.

DOCUMENT:
ALPINE DATA SERVICES s.r.o.
Krizikova 148, Praha 8, Czech Republic
EU VAT: CZ29384756

TAX INVOICE No. ADS-2025-0223

Date of issue: 1 April 2025
Due: 15 April 2025 (Net 14)
Invoice currency: EUR

Customer: Bergman Analytics BV, Amsterdam

--------------------------------------------------------------
 DESCRIPTION                      QTY    UNIT       AMOUNT
--------------------------------------------------------------
 Dedicated server hosting (mo.)    3     420.00     1,260.00
 Off-site backup add-on (mo.)      3      30.00        90.00
--------------------------------------------------------------
                                     Subtotal:      1,350.00
                                     VAT (10%):       135.00
                                     TOTAL:          1,485.00 EUR

Note: For your reference only, the total is approximately
USD 1,633.50 at today's ECB rate. Payment must be made in EUR.

```json
{
  "vendor_name": "ALPINE DATA SERVICES s.r.o.",
  "invoice_number": "ADS-2025-0223",
  "invoice_date": "2025-04-01",
  "due_date": "2025-04-15",
  "currency": "EUR",
  "subtotal": 1350.00,
  "tax_amount": 135.00,
  "total": 1485.00,
  "line_items": [
    {"description": "Dedicated server hosting (mo.)", "quantity": 3, "unit_price": 420.00, "amount": 1260.00},
    {"description": "Off-site backup add-on (mo.)", "quantity": 3, "unit_price": 30.00, "amount": 90.00}
  ]
}
```
